newsitem.title: USA: Irvine Sensors CEO Lian resigns.
newsitem.headline: Irvine Sensors CEO Lian resigns.

text.p: Irvine Sensors Corp said Kenneth Lian resigned as chief executive officer and a director, but remains at the company as senior vice president and chief operating officer.
Chairman James Alexiou has resumed the responsibilities of president and chief executive officer. Alexiou retired from those posta about a year ago, the company said.
"My immediate focus is to restructure our operations to stem our losses while exploiting the near-term opportunities available to us from our technologies," Alexiou said in a statement.
